100198.synopsis:
“Never, under any circumstances, fall in love with the protagonist.”
The Dimension Management Bureau is an organization dedicated to maintaining balance across worlds by preserving the integrity of original stories. 
One of its employees, Herace Schule, is tasked with resolving an unprecedented anomaly—one that hasn’t occurred in a thousand years—by entering the male-oriented fantasy harem novel, ‘The Black Sheep Swordsmanship Genius of a Magical Family.’
However, every time he crosses paths with the protagonist, Luke, things spiral out of control in the most unexpected ways.
“Dammit! If you touch me, I’ll kill you!”  
“I’m not touching you! I swear I won’t!” 
“Crazy bastard! Stop it! Get lost, you son of a—ugh!”
It’s bad enough having to witness the protagonist, sold into s*avery and drugged into a state of arousal, panting helplessly.

100966.synopsis:
Lin Youyi is a robot cub in a future world . His sole mission from birth to the death is to bring happiness to his master’s family.
His master once had a happy family, until they gave birth to a young son who died soon after. Lin Youyi’s is to replace the master’ young son and fill the void in master’s heart of missing his beloved son.
In the future world, the status of robots is too low. His human parents and siblings only regarded him as toy for nostalgia and entertainment.
When the robot’s life reaches an end, Lin Youyi’s last wish was to become a real child of a family and be able to understand human emotions.
Later, he died.
But when he opened his eyes again, Lin Youyi found that he had traveled through time and space.
He traveled to a parallel world where he became a human cub—a three-and-a-half-year-old boy with delusional disorder in his master’s family.
Lin Youyi thought that he would not be valued after becoming the master’s child again, but he tried to please his parents and become a cub that humans’ liked.
But, this time he found that his human parents loved him very much.
His mother was no longer indifferent to him as before, and put him first.
His father, who never cared about him, would patiently play childish games with him.
His sister, who always ignored him, would buy him a lot of snacks.
His brother, who never showed his emotions, would sweat anxiously when he got hurt.
During this period, his mother took him on a popular variety show.
Everyone liked him in the variety show.
In order to prevent him from being bullied, the assistant director started to protect him throughout the whole process.
The aunts in the live broadcast room were afraid that black fans would attack him, so they moderated the comments 24/7.
Even the bigwigs in the entertainment industry would do anything to get on the show to see him.
He also has a little big brother who is only gentle to him.
It’s just that Brother Xiaoxin has a strong desire to control and often asked him, “Youyou, besides your own brother, which brother do you like the most?”
Lin You pouted his pink and tender mouth and kissed Brother Xiaoxin on the cheek, “It’s Brother Xiaoxin~”
After Brother Xiaoxin left in satisfaction, he whispered, “Youyou is so annoyed by being asked this every day…”

101478.synopsis:
Yan Hongyin saved a man.

She lacked nothing – status, martial arts, or wealth.
All she required of her husband was that he be good-looking, harmless, and not one of those martial artists that cause trouble on weekdays.

Alright, let’s go hang out at your place!”This is the story of a former bully from elementary school—a mean-spirited TS girl who has now returned to the local high school as a flawless, perfect beauty on the outside. However, she’s become so annoyingly popular with guys that she orders the boy she used to bully to act as her fake boyfriend.

106086.synopsis:
“Whose child is it?”
Winston and Yu-jin were once passionately in love, but due to a misunderstanding, they separated. Even now, Winston believes Yu-jin was involved in an affair with his father. After being cruelly abandoned, Yu-jin struggled to survive alone while raising his daughter, never expecting to cross paths with Winston again.
Then one day, a fire forces Yu-jin out of his apartment, leaving him and his daughter homeless. At his lowest point, he learns that Winston’s father, Harold Campbell, left him an inheritance in his will. Desperate for any help, he decides to visit the Campbell estate.
When they meet again, Winston still despises him, while Yu-jin only wishes to collect his inheritance and leave. To his surprise, Harold has left him far more than expected—but with one condition: he must marry Winston and bear another child within a year.
Yu-jin tries to refuse, but reality is harsh. Fueled by resentment over Winston’s continued cruelty, he agrees to the marriage out of spite. Winston, on the other hand, makes it clear that their union is nothing more than a formality to fulfill the will.
Yet, despite their intentions, an undeniable pull keeps drawing them back to each other. Both insist it’s nothing but lust, desperately ignoring the emotions that refuse to fade…

I was executed for treason. When I opened my eyes again, somehow, I was thirty years in the future inside the body of one of my own descendants.

The only things crawling around are bugs and leeches.

All I wanted was to pay off the debt and become a rich, lazy bum. But then—

117606.synopsis:
[Welcome to World of Karma! Have you enjoyed making other’s lives spiral down to hell?] 
Park Doyoon, a clickbaiting entertainment reporter, is now the leader of a failed idol group.

121958.synopsis:
“So now even if I r*pe you, you can’t say a word, right? You said this was your fate.”

Meanwhile, Sihyeon, who entered the Center thanks to his dangerously violent power, can’t stand how Taeeun, despite having everything stolen from him, still refuses to submit.
Infuriated by Taeeun’s defiance, Sihyeon is torn between the urge to utterly destroy him—and the desire to make him completely, undeniably his.
But Taeeun, who shudders at the very thought of Sihyeon, only pushes him away.
To make matters worse, Taeeun suddenly undergoes a dual manifestation as a Sentinel himself—and becomes doubly bonded to Junwon, a Guide who has harbored unspoken love for him for years…

122470.synopsis:
He’s been her brother’s friend for 17 years.
To Yeoul, Yoo Jin-hyun was just that—nothing more, nothing less.But after she ends up appearing on his show at his suggestion, she starts to see him differently.
“PD Yoo, aren’t you staring a bit too hard?”
“You’re cute, you know.”
At some point, his words, the places where his gaze lingers—it all starts to drive her crazy.
“Do you have someone you like right now or not?”
“…I do.”
Ah. Yeoul had no choice but to admit it.
The man she swore she would never fall for had somehow found a place in her heart.It was the peak of summer,
the beginning of a feverish, one-sided love.
“…Want to come in for some ramen?”
“Na Yeoul.”
With a much lower voice, Jin-hyun called her name and pointed toward the entrance of his apartment.
“Get inside while I’m still letting you go nicely.”
As if telling her this was the last chance to stop, Jin-hyun strode up to her in large steps and cupped the back of her head with his big hand.
Seeing Yeoul tightly shut her eyes and hold her breath, Jin-hyun let out a low chuckle.
“You think ramen is all I want to have at your place?”
 With the corners of his lips lifted, Jin-hyun was no longer just the warm, kind brother’s friend she used to know.

122982.synopsis:
Since I was young, I’ve been a liar, surviving on my wits alone.
I finally managed to concoct a respectable background and infiltrated the Shen Family as a high-ranking maid. However, before I could enjoy the good life, the Shen Family was raided and wiped out overnight.
Amidst the chaos, I overheard the Steward telling someone, “The Shen Family is merely cooperating with the princess’s play; don’t harm the innocent.”
My mind raced, and I grabbed the Shen Family’s foolish Miss and ran.
A loyal servant saving their master-this act is far more rewarding than being a maid!

123238.synopsis:
Global Digitization, Games Overturn Reality, Monsters Run Rampant, Dungeons Rise Everywhere—The Era of Universal Class Change Arrives.
Lu Ran becomes a Necromancer, but unlike other Necromancers, he unlocks a golden trait every five levels.
[Trait: Celestial Master Borrows Power – All Skills Have No Cooldown] 
While others are still cautiously strategizing teamwork in dungeons, Lu Ran has already solo-entered a large-scale raid.
An endless skeletal army charges ahead, followed by dense hordes of Bone Monarchs, while the skies darken with thousands of Abyssal Bone Dragons. The dungeon boss trembles in fear!
[Trait: Transfer Flowers to Wood – All Damage is Redirected to Summons] 
As Lu Ran gazes upon the undead legion he casually summoned, even he can’t think of a way to kill himself. So long as the undead remain, Lu Ran is an immortal entity!
[Trait: All-Encompassing Sea – All Skill Ranges Expand by 9999x]

124262.synopsis:

Even better—there are unbelievable social benefits! With just a monthly income of 200 to 300, you can enjoy a relaxed schedule of three workdays and four days off, plus a built-in seven-day vacation every month.
But…
“A witch’s fate definitely depends on her own efforts, but you also have to consider the course of history.”
“I’m not trying to be humble, but how did I, just an ordinary witch, end up being chosen as the Great Witch?”
“But the Chief Witch told me everyone at the meeting already decided—it’s you. You’re the next Great Witch.”
—Excerpt from The Great Witch Internal Bulletin

133990.synopsis:
A busy but precious daily life raising a child with a high school girl.
Kuremoto Kyōta is a high school student and doting onii-chan who loves his 3-year-old sister. With both of his parents working, he handles the housework and childcare. 
Akiyama Sumi is a solitary, beautiful, and brilliant girl whose presence keeps everyone at a distance. 
One day, at his sister’s kindergarten entrance ceremony, Kyōta spots Sumi with her cheeks flushed, clicking away on her camera like a professional photographer. “Iku, you’re so adorable…” It turns out she was an incredibly devoted nee-chan, too!
Learning that they both take care of their younger siblings, they slowly grow closer. Cooking, dropping off their siblings at kindergarten, weekend outings… their relationship was exactly like “mom friends.” 
And so, their romantic-comedy-style childcare story begins!

139110.synopsis:
I married the man I had longed for so much, Halley Dike.
“I don’t want to embrace a woman I don’t have feelings for out of mere consideration.”
Five years have passed since that hurtful wedding night, but to him, I’m still just a woman he has no feelings for.
Just when I had lost my way forward, my husband’s first love appeared.
The moment I saw him smiling at her, I realized.
“Take her as your mistress. If that’s not enough, I’ll even consider divorce.”
For the sake of your first love, the time has come for me to let go of mine.
* * *
“Are you thinking of remarrying Luiden Hince?”
“Well, that’s not something I should discuss with someone who will soon be a stranger to me, is it?”
The two fists I had placed on the table trembled uncontrollably.
‘Soon to be a stranger.’
I never knew those words would become daggers slicing through my heart.

149350.synopsis:
Everyone said Bai Wu was a freak.
As a sub-beastman, he didn’t play, socialize, or fall in love. His greatest hobby was collecting various seeds and planting them, which grew sparsely. It was a pity; the entire bird-beastman tribe couldn’t find a sub-beastman as handsome as him—he was just mentally unstable.
Later, the crops Bai Wu grew helped the entire tribe survive a harsh winter; it was the first time the tribe had survived a severe winter without starvation.
Then, Bai Wu opened a general store in the tribe’s first stone house. The variety of food and supplies inside was dazzling.
The store was run by the bird tribe’s top expert, a cold and tall priest, famously aloof. The priest, who previously insisted on flying to the Heavenly Lake to bathe, calmly assessed and traded goods in the low stone house, all to become Bai Wu’s chosen one.
Only then did the tribe realize that Bai Wu wasn’t a freak; he was a god.
